text:
anita: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/usage. Folks asked about per-route billing, ratecap exceptions, and burst behavior — capturing answers here.

liam: TL;DR: billing = tokens at org/project level. Console shows per-route breakdown for visibility only, not separate invoices.

sasha: Finance: to invoice separately you'd need separate orgs/accounts. One-off credits require finance approval; no automatic goodwill credits.

kevin: Ops: ratecap exceptions are an allowlist flag in control plane. Right now support -> ops flips it manually. No self-serve yet.

anita: Customers asked about turnaround times for exemptions (some want <24h).

kevin: Targets: enterprise 24h, standard 48h. For urgent partner work we can issue short-lived burst tokens while exemption is processed.

liam: Burst details: token-bucket limiter with ~30s burst window by default. Short spikes ok; sustained overage => 429s. Dedicated/private deployments can request tuned profiles.

sasha: Finance will prepare an approval template for credit adjustments and exemptions. Legal/sales sign-off required for exceptions with billing impacts.

maria: Roadmap note: self-serve exemption UI and per-route billing granularity on roadmap. Engineering RFC + spike next sprint; public ETA tentatively Q3.

anita: Action items: liam - RFC + doc stub; kevin - emergency runbook for temporary burst tokens; sasha - finance approval template.

deploy-bot: docs: /docs/ops/credits-exemptions.md created by liam - https://redwood.docs/credits-exemptions

anita: Please include a sample config snippet (e.g., `rate_limit_exempt: true // per-org-id`) in the doc.

liam: Will add examples and caveats.

kevin: I'll add steps to revoke tokens and monitor for misuse.

sasha: Sharing the finance template in #finance-review for signoff.

anita: Thanks everyone — I'll add this to the all-hands notes and follow up when RFC is ready.
